'''2016 Texas Mini Worlds''' was a Players Committee match-play major in Houston, Texas, 28–30 October 2016. [[Steve Baroni]] is the published winner.<ref name="pc">https://www.starwarsccg.org/2016-texas-mini-worlds/</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Open]]
* '''Site:''' Houston, Texas
* '''Dates:''' 28–30 October 2016
* '''Winner:''' [[Steve Baroni]]
